verdict.rationale: Custom observability dashboards are a fair question for a cloud platform like Fly.io, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions metrics, dashboards, or combining data across services. The one related item, a user running Uptime Kuma on Fly, is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can build custom dashboards combining metrics from any service
